# Awesome AI Perks & Free Compute (2026)

A curated, regularly updated directory of **legitimate official AI free tiers, API credits, GPU compute grants, creator tools, and student privileges**—built so developers and builders don't overpay or rely on shady resellers.

> **Interactive Web Version (Live Status + Community Votes)**
> - English Directory: [AI Radar — Free AI Perks & Credits](https://radar.aitoolnet.com/perks)
> - 中文版福利与情报库: [AI Radar — 2026 全球 AI 羊毛与福利情报库](https://radar.aitoolnet.com/zh/perks)

---

## Developer APIs & Free Compute

| Platform | Free Tier / Grant | Card Needed | Official Link | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- |
| **Google AI Studio** | 1,500 requests/day on Gemini models (1M-2M context) | No | [aistudio.google.com/apikey](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) | No credit card needed on free tier |
| **OpenRouter (`:free`)** | Unified OpenAI-compatible key for 25+ `:free` models (DeepSeek R1/V3, Llama 3.3) | No | [openrouter.ai/models?q=:free](https://openrouter.ai/models?q=:free) | ~200 req/day at $0 balance (1,000/day with $10+ top-up) |
| **Cloudflare Workers AI** | 10,000 free Neurons/day (LLMs, Whisper, BGE-M3 embeddings) | No | [dash.cloudflare.com](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/ai/workers-ai) | Resets daily at 00:00 UTC |
| **Groq & Cerebras** | High-speed LPU/WSE free RPM inference tier | No | [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com) | Low-latency streaming inference |
| **SiliconFlow (硅基流动)** | 14M-20M free tokens for DeepSeek-V3, Qwen & FLUX.1 | No | [siliconflow.cn](https://siliconflow.cn) | OpenAI-compatible endpoint |
| **Zhipu BigModel (智谱)** | `glm-4-flash` official $0 API tier | No | [open.bigmodel.cn](https://open.bigmodel.cn) | Explicit `glm-4-flash` model ID stays $0 |
| **Kaggle** | 30 hours/week free P100 / Dual-T4 GPU compute | No | [kaggle.com](https://www.kaggle.com) | Phone-verified Jupyter environment |
| **Continue.dev / Cline** | Zero-subscription VS Code AI coding setup | No | [continue.dev](https://continue.dev) | Pair with free-tier DeepSeek / Groq / OpenRouter keys |
